definitions.explanation: The length of a garment measured from top to bottom, such as the length of a skirt, sleeve, or trousers. By extension, a person's height or the full extent of something.

examples.japanese: スカートの{丈|たけ}が{短|みじか}い。
ズボンの{丈|たけ}を{少|すこ}し{詰|つ}めてもらった。
examples.english: I had the trousers shortened a little.

examples.japanese: {袖|そで}の{丈|たけ}が{長|なが}すぎたので、お{店|みせ}で{直|なお}してもらった。
examples.english: The sleeve length was too long, so I had it altered at the shop.

notes:
Most commonly refers to the length of clothing (skirts, sleeves, trousers). Also refers to a person's height or, in set phrases, the full extent of something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丈|たけ}が{長|なが}い / {短|みじか}い: to be long / short (in length)
- {丈|たけ}を{詰|つ}める: to shorten (a hem)
- {背丈|せたけ}: one's height; stature
- {思|おも}いの{丈|たけ}: the full extent of one's feelings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {長|なが}さ: length — general measurement of length; {丈|たけ} specifically suits clothing and height
- {身長|しんちょう}: height (of a person) — the technical term for a person's height
